lane.ordering: Touch Began and successful judgement may retrigger Idle; judgement calls On then OffReserve in one outer frame. Counter 2 is consumed by that same outer update and the next outer update enters AnimatedOff; retrigger restarts Idle. Touch Ended calls AnimatedOff directly.

worldComposition.ownerParent: exact GamePlayButton Transform selected by the note caller
worldComposition.systemLocal: serialized ParticleSystem Transform followed by every serialized parent Transform
worldComposition.camera: orthographic world point = GamePlayButton anchor + emitted system-parent-chain point; Pixi top-left projection is x=viewport/2+worldX*height/2 and y=height/2-worldY*height/2
worldComposition.sorting: ParticleSystemRenderer sortingOrder, then system identity and creation sequence; lane sortingOrder 0 remains below particle orders 1/5/50

lifecycle.pause: simulation freezes and lane is all-off
lifecycle.moveTime: clear-all then suppress until whole-engine replay

acceptance.lane: all 13 slots, exact On/OffReserve/AnimatedOff/Off, retrigger and all cleanup transitions must be compared as ordered primitive mutations
acceptance.particle: Normal/Flick/Directional/finger must compare root, button owner, system-parent matrix, material, blend, sorting and screen point in the judgement frame
